summary: High-yield crypto and fiat rewards platform whose Supercharger products offered returns of up to 43%, halted buy-backs and withdrawals in October 2022 after trading losses, and later entered official liquidation in the Cayman Islands.
what_happened: Freeway marketed Supercharger products linked to crypto and fiat assets and advertised unusually high annual rewards. On 23 October 2022 it stopped Supercharger buy-backs and related transactions, initially citing market volatility. It later attributed the halt to a failed trading strategy and substantial losses. AuBit International, the company affiliated with the Freeway platform, was placed into official liquidation in the Cayman Islands in October 2023.
uncertainty_notes: The approximate launch date should be refined with an archived first-party launch source. Corporate structure involved multiple AuBit and Freeway entities across jurisdictions; this record follows the customer-facing Freeway platform and the AuBit International liquidation most directly connected to Supercharger holders.
notes: Added as a major centralized high-yield platform failure with a documented withdrawal halt and Cayman official liquidation.
